每行请填写「物料号=类型」: Use material number=type on each line.
同一物料号只能指定一种审核类型: Assign only one review type per material.
按物料名称匹配，多个分类命中时标记为需关注。: Keywords match material names. Matches in more than one category are flagged for review.
按物料号指定审核类型: Override review type by material number
每行填写「物料号=类型」，支持 small、maintenance、danger: Enter material number=type on each line. Available types are small, maintenance, dangerous, manual, no_stock and normal.
更换基础标准会重置本页修改，继续？: Changing the base standard will reset your edits. Continue?
新范围只带入审核规则，本仓物料主数据留在原仓。继续？: Only the review rules will carry over. Material master data stays with its warehouse. Continue?

现行规则（试算时）: Active rule at time of test
旧试算未记录具体字段: Field details unavailable for this earlier test
使用文件提供的审核前净额，约定需求已扣，本次计划未计入。: Uses the file’s pre-review net supply. Agreed demand has been deducted and the current plan is excluded.
在库 + 在途 + 在订 − 约定需求，需求尚未在分项中抵扣，本次计划未计入。: On hand + in transit + on order − agreed demand. The components are before demand deductions and exclude the current plan.
按库存、在途、在订和需求分项计算: Calculate from on-hand stock, in-transit stock, open orders and demand
使用英国0804原表中的净额和目标值。: Uses the net supply and targets from the UK 0804 workbook.
按分项重算净额。基础快照需含在库、在途、在订和未扣减的需求。: Net supply is recalculated from components. The base snapshot must include on-hand stock, stock in transit, open orders and demand before deduction.
表头与模板不同时，填写来源列名。: Enter the source column names when they differ from the template.

物料专用周期优先，其次取分类周期，再取通用周期。缺少计算依据时沿用来源目标。: Material-specific coverage takes priority, followed by class coverage and then default coverage. Source targets are used when the calculation lacks inputs.
